relationships.subject: COMT
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that inhibition of COMT enhances TNF-α expression through miR-155 induced signaling pathways.

relationships.subject: miR-155
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicated that up-regulation of TNF-α can be prevented by anti-miR-155 in FHs 74 Int and FHC CRL cells treated with si-COMT, LPS, or their combination.

relationships.subject: COMT
relationships.evidence_quote: Over-expression of COMT decreased NF-κB p65 transcriptional activity with/without LPS treatment

relationships.subject: miR-155
relationships.evidence_quote: luciferase reporter assays were carried out and confirmed that SHIP-1 is the direct target of miR-155 in colon epithelial cells

key_findings: Decreased colonic COMT in PI-IBS-D drives abdominal pain via the COMT/miR-155/TNF-α axis.
COMT-/- mice show increased miR-155 and TNF-α in colon and DRG; miR-155 knockout reduces TNF-α and prevents visceral hypersensitivity.
